identity.tagline: Boxing, strength and conditioning classes in North Hollywood. Your first class is free.
identity.description: A coach-led gym for boxing, strength training and conditioning. Classes are capped at fourteen, beginners are welcome at every one, and your first class is on us.
identity.story:
Coach Andre Little boxed as an amateur for ten years before opening Ember in a North Hollywood warehouse in 2020.

We built it for people who want real coaching without the attitude: wraps on, phones away, and someone watching your form every set.

faqs.question: I'm a complete beginner. Is that OK?
faqs.answer: Yes. Every class has beginners in it, and the coaches scale each round to where you are.

faqs.question: What should I bring?
faqs.answer: Water, a towel, and hand wraps if you have them. We lend gloves and wraps for your first visits.

faqs.question: Is the first class really free?
faqs.answer: Yes. Book any class online and tell the coach it is your first time.

posts.title: A new 6am class starts in March
posts.excerpt: Fight conditioning before work, on Monday, Wednesday and Friday.
posts.body_md:
You asked, and **fight conditioning** is coming to the early slot.

## The details

- Monday, Wednesday and Friday at *6am*
- Forty-five minutes, capped at fourteen
- Open to every level

[Book your spot](https://book.example/ember); the first week fills fast.
